title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E4 — Card Sharps
Fred is convinced that Lamont's card-playing buddies are trying to sock it to him for every cent he's got, but Lamont won't believe him. Fred's attempts at signaling Lamont create nothing but constant turmoil.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E5 — Whiplash
After Fred has an accident in the pick-up truck, he decides he is suffering from whiplash. Fred's friend Bubba (Don Bexley) convinces him he is sitting on a gold mine. Lamont, on the other hand, is sure his father is faking.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E6 — Have Gun, Will Sell
Lamont and his friend Rollo (Nathaniel Taylor) scare off a burglar in the Sanford house, but he leaves something behind -- a gun. Rollo convinces Fred and Lamont that they could make some money if they pawn the gun, but the scheme explodes.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E7 — The Dowry
Fred's cousin and his new bride visit from St. Louis with the idea of finding a husband for his cousin's new stepdaughter. When Fred learns there's a $10,000 dowry involved, he schemes to get Lamont to ask for her hand in marriage.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E13 — George Needs Help
When George stubbornly refuses to hire some badly needed help for his store, Louise and Florence combine forces to make him change his mind.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E14 — The Jefferson Curve
After watching George Jefferson in action, his young protege Marcus bends the truth to win the heart of a young lady and throws a curve that lands Lionel in foul territory.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E15 — 984 W. 124th., Apt. 5c
When Louise discovers that George has been sending presents and money to a mysterious address, she follows him to find out why and is shocked...and touched by what she sees.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E16 — George And Whitty
George and Louise are stunned by their landlord Whittendale's plans to evict them, but their biggest surprise is yet to come when they invite him down to discuss it.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E17 — Lionel Gets The Business
George is on cloud nine when he finally persuades Lionel to join him in the family's cleaning business -- until Lionel starts taking him to the cleaners.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E18 — Blackout, The
George blows a fuse when a power blackout hits the city and looters do the same to his store.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E19 — Florence's Union
Florence wants to form a union for maids and succeeds in breaking up the whole household.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E20 — Barbara Feldon, Art Carney, Hal Frazier
Cast parodies Mission Impossible; Flip chats with Hal; sketches incl. a gangster at the veterinarian and bowling night.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E21 — Aretha Franklin, Charlie Callas, David Frost
Cast spoofs panel show & secret agent movies; Callas does stand-up and Aretha joins the Church Of What’s Happening Now.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E23 — Tim Conway, Robert Klein, Diahann Carroll
Flip & Tim teach poker; Freddie Johnson meets Diahann at a society party and Klein does Borscht Belt routine.

title: The Best Of Flip Wilson
description:
S1 E24 — Ray Stevens, George Carlin, Lena Horne
Carlin does a monologue on NYC cops; Flip fixes Ray Stevens’ TV set; Rev. Leroy visits Lena Horne at a nightclub.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E17 — Shades of Soul! - Part 1
Felipe Luciano hosts this showcase of Latin music on Soul! Features musicians Tito Puente and Willie Colon, accompanied by their musical groups.

title: Soul!: The Complete Series
description:
S1 E18 — Shades of Soul! - Part 2
Female singing trio LaBelle and conga drum/bongo musician Mongo Santamaria, are guests of Ellis Haizlip.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E22 — Farewell to Arms
Webster asks permission to buy a BB gun and he resorts to responsibility to get one. After getting one, and practicing with his friends, he accidentally kills a bird. This bird has babies and he takes the responsibility of raising them on his own.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E27 — My Family's Honor
Webster and Katherine both end up cheating on some school-related projects at the same time.

title: Webster
description:
S3 E29 — Rear View Mirror (Part 2)
As they continue to reminisce, Webster, Papa Papadapolis, and Jerry receive news that George and Katherine have both survived the hurricane.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E1 — The Landlords
George and Katherine, who bought Bill & Cassie's house, have a three-ring circus with the clown they found to rent the downstairs apartment.

title: Webster
description:
S4 E2 — The Derby
George is so obsessed with Webster winning a derby that he builds the car without him, hurting his feelings since Webster wanted to build the car together.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E1 — Designer Genes
Tia and Tamera slip backstage at a red-hot fashion show.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E2 — A Separate Peace
Fed up with sharing the same bedroom, the twins are torn between getting their own rooms.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E3 — Working Girls
Ray's budding relationship with a new woman leaves Tamera feeling jealous.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E4 — Show Me the Money
When Tamera learns that Tia is being paid less than a male co-worker, she poses as Tia.

title: Sister, Sister
description:
S5 E5 — It's My Party
The twins sneak to Chicago to celebrate their 17th birthday.

title: Moesha
description:
S1 E4 — Hakeem Owes Moesha Big
Moesha and her father coach Hakeem on how to get a job.  As a result, the owner of a sporting goods store (Bo Jackson) hires him.
